A '''drill sergeant''' was a militaristic noncommissioned duty. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] made the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bric/Legends|Bric]] a drill [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] as he conditioned [[Clone cadet/Legends|clone cadets]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].
